errors.text_span: за различни варианти на изходно затваряне на SDPA,
errors.evidence: This information is not present in the figure itself (title, axes, legend). It appears to be taken from the broader context of the paper (the caption) and is an interpretation beyond the visual data provided in the chart.
The x-axis data ends around layer 22-23, not 25. The axis tick marks shown on the plot only go up to 20.
None of the four lines in the plot have any markers. The description incorrectly adds 'round markers' to all of them.
The 'min' line is a green dash-dot line, not a solid ('плътна') line.
The 'mean' line does not stabilize at 0.65. After layer 5, it continues to steadily decrease, reaching a value of approximately 0.57 by the end of the plot.

errors.text_span: Линията „std“ започва при около 0.05 при слой 0, расте до около 0.12 при слой 5
errors.evidence: The 'std' line starts at a value closer to 0.02 (not 0.05) and is at approximately 0.07 at layer 5 (not 0.12). These are significant inaccuracies.

errors.text_span: Линията „min“ започва при около 0.65 при слой 0, спада до около 0.55 при слой 5, след което се стабилизира на около 0.53
errors.evidence: The 'min' line starts at approximately 0.6 (not 0.65), and after an initial spike, it drops to and stabilizes at exactly 0.5 (not 0.55 or 0.53).
The description of the 'min' line fails to mention the prominent initial spike from ~0.6 at layer 0 to ~0.7 at layer 1 before the line drops.
The description of the 'max' line omits the small dip in value that occurs around layer 2 before the line begins its steady rise towards 1.0.

errors.text_span: „mean“ е изобразена с тъмносиня пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери, „std“ – с оранжева пунктирна линия
errors.evidence: The description uses the same word 'пунктирана' (dashed/dotted) for both the 'mean' (dashed) and 'std' (dotted) lines, failing to distinguish between the two different line styles.
The data on the x-axis appears to end at layer 23, not 24.

errors.text_span: increases to a peak of 1.0 around layer 4
errors.evidence: The red 'max' line reaches a value of 1.0 around layer 6, not layer 4. At layer 4, its value is approximately 0.94.

errors.text_span: decreases to a minimum of 0.58 at layer 2
errors.evidence: The blue 'mean' line does not reach a minimum at layer 2; its value there is approximately 0.72. The line's overall minimum occurs at the end of the range, around layer 23, with a value of approximately 0.56.
The legend shows that the 'min' line has a dash-dotted style, not a dotted style.

errors.text_span: drops to a minimum of 0.52 at layer 2
errors.evidence: The green 'min' line's value at layer 2 is approximately 0.55. It reaches its stable minimum value of approximately 0.5 around layer 5, not at layer 2.

errors.text_span: remains stable at 0.52 for the rest of the layers
errors.evidence: The green 'min' line stabilizes at a value of approximately 0.5, not 0.52.
The legend shows that the 'std' line has a dotted style, not a dash-dotted style.

errors.text_span: and then slightly decreases to 0.13 at layer 24
errors.evidence: The chart's x-axis and data do not extend to layer 24. The last data point is at layer 23, so any description of behavior at layer 24 is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Verteilung der Gating-Scores für verschiedene Varianten der SDPA-Ausgabegating,
errors.evidence: This part of the description is taken from the paper's caption, not from the figure itself. The figure's title is 'atten_output_gate_wo_sparsity gate values'.
The blue line representing the mean is dashed ('gestrichelt'), not solid ('durchgezogen').
The blue line has no markers. The description hallucinates round markers.

errors.text_span: fällt dann allmählich auf etwa 0.56 bei Schicht 24
errors.evidence: The x-axis data points go up to layer 23, not 24. This error is repeated for all lines.
The orange line representing 'std' is dotted ('gepunktet'), not dashed with dots.
The green line representing 'min' is dash-dotted ('strichpunktiert'), not solid ('durchgezogen').
The green line has no markers. The description hallucinates square markers.
This description misses a key feature of the 'min' line: it spikes up significantly between layer 0 and layer 1 before falling.
The red line has no markers. The description hallucinates circular markers.
This description incorrectly states the 'max' line rises to 0.97 by layer 2. In fact, the line dips from layer 0 to layer 2 before starting its main ascent.

errors.text_span: bleibt dann nahezu konstant bei Werten über 0.97
errors.evidence: The red 'max' line reaches and stays exactly at the value of 1.0 from layer 8 onwards. Describing this as 'nearly constant at values above 0.97' is imprecise.
